title: KLIA1 to KLIA2: Train, Shuttle Bus or Taxi
metaDescription: KLIA1 to KLIA2 takes about 3 minutes on the KLIA Transit for RM2. Where to board the train, the shuttle bus or a taxi at each terminal, both ways.

contentBlocks.content: KLIA Terminal 1 (KLIA1) and KLIA2 are separate terminals, about 2 km apart. The quickest way between them is the KLIA Transit train: about 3 minutes and RM2 for an adult. Malaysia Airports also runs a shuttle bus round the clock, free for passengers with connecting flights. With a family or heavy bags, a booked taxi takes you door to door. Pick the one that fits the hour and your luggage.
Key Takeaways
What is the fastest way from KLIA1 to KLIA2? The train. It takes about 3 minutes between the two terminals (KLIA Ekspres).
How much is the train? RM2 for an adult and RM1 for a child aged 6 to 15 on the KLIA Transit. Children under 6 ride free (KLIA Transit).
Is there a free shuttle bus? Malaysia Airports runs a shuttle every 15 minutes, round the clock, free for passengers with connecting flights (Malaysia Airports).
Can I walk between KLIA1 and KLIA2? No. Take the train, the shuttle bus or a car.

Train times and fares checked on 11 October 2026 on the KLIA Ekspres website. Shuttle details are from Malaysia Airports on the same day. Check both again on the day you travel.
KLIA1 to KLIA2
By train

Go down to the train station on Level 1 of the KLIA1 main terminal. Buy a KLIA Transit ticket to KLIA T2 at the counter, a machine or online; the adult fare is RM2. The KLIA Ekspres also calls at both terminals, but the RM2 fare is listed on the KLIA Transit fare table, so ask at the counter which trains your ticket covers. Your ticket is valid for 90 minutes from entry. At KLIA2, the platforms are on Level 1 of Gateway@klia2. Follow the signs up to departures.
If your flight parks at a satellite gate at KLIA1, take the Aerotrain to the main terminal first. Allow for that walk and ride before you head for the train.
By shuttle bus

The shuttle stop at KLIA1 is at Door 4 on Level 1. Malaysia Airports describes the shuttle as free for passengers with connecting flights, running every 15 minutes, round the clock, on a loop from Terminal 1 to Terminal 2, the Long Term Car Park and back. Keep your boarding pass or booking to hand when you board.
By taxi

With children, a pushchair or several suitcases, a car is simpler. ttklia.com sells a fixed price taxi from KLIA to KLIA2 by sedan, MPV or van, with the price fixed when you book. Book it before you land.
KLIA2 to KLIA1
By train

After customs, leave the arrival hall by Door B and walk into Gateway@klia2. The KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit counters and machines are on Level 2; the platforms are one floor down on Level 1. The first KLIA Transit leaves KLIA2 at 5:18 AM and the last at 12:30 AM. Ticket counters close at 11 PM, so buy online or at a machine if you are late. Buy your RM2 ticket and go down to the platform.
By shuttle bus

The shuttle leaves from Bay A10 on Level 1, in the Transportation Hub. The walk is the same as to the bus station: Door B, straight through Gateway@klia2, left after FamilyMart and down the travelator. Our KLIA2 bus station guide has the walk on video. Watch it before you land.
By taxi

A booked taxi driver tracks your flight and waits in the KLIA2 arrival hall with a name board, so you skip the walk to Level 1. Our KLIA2 taxi counter guide shows where to book at the airport if you have not booked ahead.

contentBlocks.content: Changing terminals between flights

KLIA1 and KLIA2 are separate terminals. If your next flight leaves from the other one, you may have to clear immigration, collect your bags and check in again. Ask your airline whether your bags are checked through to your final destination. If you clear immigration, you are entering Malaysia, so check whether you need an arrival card in our MDAC guide. Leave plenty of time and confirm your onward terminal on your ticket.
Staying overnight between flights
An early flight from the other terminal and a late arrival make a long night. Read staying at KLIA2 or riding now for the hotels you can use after you land, then book a bed before you fly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take from KLIA1 to KLIA2?
KLIA1 to KLIA2 takes about 3 minutes by train. The shuttle bus goes by road, so it takes longer and depends on traffic. Add time for walking to the platform or the bus stop at each end.
Is the shuttle bus between KLIA1 and KLIA2 free?

Malaysia Airports says the shuttle bus between KLIA1 and KLIA2 is free for passengers with connecting flights. It runs every 15 minutes, round the clock, from Door 4, Level 1 at KLIA1 and Bay A10, Level 1 at KLIA2.
How much is the train from KLIA1 to KLIA2?
The KLIA Transit from KLIA1 to KLIA2 costs RM2 for an adult and RM1 for a child aged 6 to 15. Children under 6 ride free, up to three per adult ticket.
Can I walk from KLIA1 to KLIA2?
No, you cannot walk from KLIA1 to KLIA2. The terminals are about 2 km apart. Take the train, the shuttle bus or a taxi.
What time is the last train from KLIA2 to KLIA1?
The last KLIA Transit train from KLIA2 to KLIA1 leaves at 12:30 AM, according to the KLIA Ekspres website on 11 October 2026. After that, take the shuttle bus or a taxi.
Conclusion

For KLIA1 to KLIA2, take the KLIA Transit if you travel light: about 3 minutes for RM2. Use the shuttle bus if you have a connecting flight, and a taxi if you have a family or a lot of luggage. Book your KLIA2 to KLIA taxi on ttklia.com before you fly.
